mcp_enabled.description: Whether this app serves an MCP endpoint at `/mcp/<identifier>`. Off refuses the whole OAuth surface for the app, not merely the tool calls, and is re-read on every request rather than cached off a token.

mcp_login_url.description: The page an MCP authorization redirects to, with `{interaction}` where the interaction id goes. Not a token: the id names a pending request the server already holds, and the app authenticates the user itself before approving it.
